# ModDotPlot Browser v0.9.5

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.9.5 makes **Export ModDotPlot command** a reliable single-download action. It saves
`<plot-name>.zip`, containing exactly:

```text
<plot-name>.bedpe
<plot-name>.config.json
```

Browsers can block the second of two automatic downloads from one click, which caused
the earlier JSON-only result. A single ZIP avoids that policy and keeps the files
together. Extract both files into the same directory before using them.

The JSON now points to the exported data with:

```json
"load": ["./<plot-name>.bedpe"]
```

It no longer contains a `fasta` entry. Its metadata retains the explicit command:

```sh
moddotplot -c <plot-name>.config.json -l <plot-name>.bedpe
```
